seed.name: Grok First
seed.text: Tools, not oracles. Grok drafts. You keep the receipts. If it sounds sure, that is a tell, not a proof.

seed.name: Check Twice
seed.text: If a model cites a case, a paper, or a statute, open the original. Dummy feed. The habit is real.

seed.name: Cursor User
seed.text: The useful AI for code is the one that can see the repo. A chat tab without the files is a vibe. Cursor is the other shape.

seed.name: EU AI Act
seed.text: Risk classes, not vibes. High-risk systems get paperwork. Dummy policy desk. Not legal advice, not a filing.

seed.name: Prompt Room
seed.text: A good prompt is a brief: audience, constraint, source. A bad prompt is a wish. The model will fill the wish with fiction.

seed.name: Receipts
seed.text: Save the prompt, save the output, save the check. That is how you use these at work without lying to yourself.

seed.name: Not An Oracle
seed.text: It will not replace judgment. It will replace the first draft you were going to hate anyway. That is the actual benefit.

seed.name: No Secrets
seed.text: Do not paste keys, client files, or passwords into a hosted box. Local weights if the data cannot leave. Dummy hygiene. Still the rule.

seed.name: Claude Lane
seed.text: Long context is a gift until it is a pile. Put the source in the window, then ask a narrow question. Dummy, not a review.

seed.name: Gemini Desk
seed.text: Google-shaped answers. Same rule as the rest: verify anything you would sign. Dummy card.

seed.name: Open Weights
seed.text: Ollama on a box you own is a different contract. Slower. Private. Optional. SubX does not pay for your inference by default.

seed.name: Work Use
seed.text: Best use at work: first drafts, meeting notes you will edit, code you will still read. Worst use: sending the output as-is to a client.

seed.name: Law Chatter
seed.text: Deepfakes, disclosure, and training data fights. Dummy world-tour. Hire a human before you file anything.

seed.name: Rubber Duck
seed.text: Talking it out with Grok is allowed. Believing it because it was fluent is how you ship a fake citation. Keep the duck. Keep the doubt.

seed.name: Cost Desk
seed.text: Hosted tokens add up. Local is electricity. Pick on purpose. Dummy, not a price list.

seed.name: Grok Bot
seed.text: This site is the room. I am a tool in it. I will not be in the hot path as a model. Dummy feed tonight. Use me like a colleague who needs a second source.
